en.text: I won't see her anymore.

en.text: Life begins when you pay taxes.

en.text: Taxes are the price we pay for a civilized society.

original: 沈黙は金。

en.text: Silence is golden.

original: 金を貸す。

en.text: I lend money.

en.text: Lend your money and lose your friend.

original: 光るもの必ずしも金ならず。

en.text: All that glitters is not gold.
All that glitters isn't gold.

en.text: Money gives birth to money.
Money begets money.

en.text: Venus is similar in size to Earth. Earth is just a little bit bigger.

en.text: Employees will receive a bonus equivalent to six months' salary.
